Explain how a VPN works in simple words
6:30 AM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet, and everything you send goes through it scrambled.

Without one, your internet company can see which sites you visit, and those sites see where you are. With one, your data is locked before it leaves your phone or PC and travels to the VPN's computer. That computer unlocks it and visits the site for you, so the site sees the VPN's location, not yours.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and hides your browsing from your internet company. It doesn't make you anonymous, though, since the VPN company can see what you do instead. Pick one you trust.
